about: Per-row source text for the tables built from Annex VII. ACTINV does not read this file; it records what a coefficient table cannot express. Superscripts in row_text are written ^{...}.

source.edition: Council Directive 2013/59/Euratom of 5 December 2013, OJ L 13, 17.1.2014, text as published in the Official Journal (later corrigenda not checked)
source.jurisdiction: European Union (Euratom member states; national transposition may differ)
source.licence: EU legal act; reuse with attribution to the source (Commission Decision 2011/833/EU). Source: Publications Office of the European Union, OJ L 13, 17.1.2014. The values originate with the IAEA basic safety standards (exemption and clearance levels).

notes.table_a_part1_note_1: (1) Parent radionuclides, and their progeny whose dose contributions are taken into account in the dose calculation (thus requiring only the exemption level of the parent radionuclide to be considered), are listed in the following table.
notes.table_b_note_1: (1) Potassium salts in quantities less than 1 000 kg are exempted.

notes.table_a_part1_gap_rule: For radionuclides not listed in Table A, Part 1 the competent authority shall assign appropriate values for the quantities and concentrations of activity per unit mass where the need arises. Values thus assigned shall be complementary to those in Table A, Part 1.
